answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through delayed, stake-backed reputation. Each identity locks collateral and must complete unpredictable tasks verified by randomly chosen peers; copied agents pay the same bond and consume scarce review capacity. A violet receipt records each accepted result, a tundra quarantine isolates suspicious clusters, and a pulse-based reward limit prevents rapid farming. Failed audits slash collateral and reset reputation, making large-scale forgery economically irrational.
